row.notes: min(g_Sess_VehicleCount,0x1b=27) clamp on the session-enter per-vehicle init loop in Game_GameModule_OnSessionEnter: movzx ecx,[count]; cmp cl,0x1b; mov eax,0x1b; cmovb eax,ecx; loops eax times over g_Sess_VehicleTable (base lea at 0x14080c81e). Caps this loop at 27 cars regardless of count. Identical sibling clamp at 0x140173d80 (func 0x1401717b0). Behaviour-hook to lift the per-vehicle init loop above 27 for >27-car grids; harmless to 24-26 (26<27). Sig entrants.session_enter_veh_clamp.
